title: Minix 2.0.4 (classic Tanenbaum Unix, QD edition)

interactive.steer: keyboard (machine.keyIn -> 8042 + IRQ1) -- the free-386 injects scancodes, so '=' starts the kernel and 'root' logs in (the 8086 tier could not).

notes: BSD-3 Minix 2.0.4 'QD edition' combo floppy (davidgiven/minix2), run unmodified. Must boot on the FULLY-FREE 386 AT machine (LGPL Bochs BIOS + LGPL VGABios, no proprietary ROM), NOT the 8086: the 2.0.4 i86 kernel runs in 16-bit protected mode and wants ~2MB, which the 386 AT provides and the 8086/XT tier cannot. Set CMOS floppy type 0 = 1.44MB (0x10=0x40) and boot-from-floppy (0x3d=0x01). Injecting '=' at the boot monitor launches the kernel; it reaches a multiuser 'login:'. Verified via bw-board scripts/run-i80386-free-bios-freedos.mjs adapted to insert this floppy. Fetched, never re-hosted.
